player_prompt.intro:
Nang Player {player_id} ni. Nang Memory Game khelgi khudammi.
Nang gi lakpa, board da leiriba card sagi khudingmak pair khudingmakta thokpa khudingmak nang gi opponent singgi.
Nang gi turn da, card 2 ta flip toukhiba row leiriba column number singbu first leiriba second card bu respectively '[0 1 1 0]' gi matamda, first card row 0 leiriba column 1 da, leiriba second card row 1 leiriba column 0 da.
Card 2 ta match toukhiba, nang point 1 amasung card 2 ta face up toukhiba. Match toukhibasu, card 2 ta face down toukhiba, e.g. '.'.
Game over toukhiba, pair khudingmak sagi khudingmakta thokpa toukhiba.

invalid_move.wrong_format: খেলোয়ার {player_id}না স্ক্বার ব্রেকেটশিংদা ভেলিদ দিরেক্সন অমগা লোয়ননা পাউখুম পীখিদে।
invalid_move.already_matched: খেলর {player_id}না কার্দ অমত্তা নত্ত্রগা অনিমকপু হান্নদগী মেৎ তৌদুনা লৈরবা অদু খনখি।

game_message.cards_match: Khelgi {player_id} na leiriba card [{r1} {c1}] amasung [{r2} {c2}] khut ahongba!
game_message.cards_no_match: The cards selected by Player {player_id} do not match. Cards at positions [{r1} {c1}] and [{r2} {c2}] are {pos1} and {pos2} respectively.

outcome.draw: শান্নরোই অনিমক্না মান্নবা মশীংগী কার্দ জুরাশিংগা মেটচ তৌখি।
outcome.turn_limit: The turn limit has been reached. The game is over. Player 0 scored {score_0} points, Player 1 scored {score_1} points.
